items.title: The degree in which a normalized dualizing complex is nonzero at a minimal prime
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement pins down the single degree in which the cohomology of a normalized dualizing complex localized at a minimal prime is nonzero, namely minus the dimension of the quotient by that prime (author lemma at source lines 3402-3410, label lemma-nonvanishing-generically-local). The proof (source lines 3412-3434) kills a power of the prime by replacing the ring with the corresponding quotient through an internal hom that leaves the localized complex unchanged, reads the dimension off that quotient, confines the degree by the sitting in degrees statement and gets nonvanishing from the local complex being dualizing (proof lines 3430-3433). The reduction to the quotient is the substance. H3.
